items.question: Ni izihe serivisi mutanga?
items.answer: Dutuma imirimo ikorwa buri munsi mu bucuruzi yikora, tworoshya uburyo bw'akazi, kandi dukora ibisubizo byihariye bigutwara igihe bikagabanya imirimo ikorwa n'intoki.

items.question: Mwishyuza angahe?
items.answer: Ibiciro byacu biragaragara kandi bishingiye ku bukana n'ingano y'umushinga wawe. Dutanga ibiciro byiza n'uburyo bworoshye bwo kwishyura.

items.question: Umushinga umara igihe kingana iki?

Tanga umusanzu igihe ubonye umwanya
Tangira ku mirimo mito, maze urusheho kugira uruhare
Hembwa hakurikijwe umusanzu watanze

items.question: Nabigenza nte ngo ntangire gutanga umusanzu?

items.question: Natangira nte?
items.answer: Twandikire dukore inama aho tuzaganira ku byo ukeneye, ibibazo ufite n'intego zawe. Tuzakugira inama y'inzira nziza kandi tuguhe icyifuzo kirambuye.

introduction.paragraph1: Kwikora ku bintu birambirana. Kuri Databayt turimo kubaka codebase yo gutuma ubucuruzi bwikora, igice kimwe gito nyuma y'ikindi. Buri murongo wa kode ni "open source", buri musanzu urashimwa, kandi buri mukozi wa porogaramu ashobora gufasha gushyiraho ejo hazaza h'uko ubucuruzi bukora.
introduction.paragraph2: Dugurisha inkomoko y'agaciro kose — dugurisha Igihe, ifaranga riyobora isi — ubonye ute usubijeho icyawe ukita ku by'ingenzi koko? Ni ibirenze serivisi — ni uburyo bwo guhunga imvuto. Gusubirana igihe binyuze mu gukuraho imirimo isubirwamo, koroshya imikorere no gutuma inzira zikora zonyine. Wibohore. Subirana amasaha yawe.
introduction.paragraph3: Ububiko bw'ibitangaza. Tekereza codebase yacu nk'isomero rizima aho buri musanzu uba igice cy'ikintu kinini kurushaho. Kuva ku bice bito kugeza ku nyandikorugero zuzuye, kuva kuri "blocks" kugeza kuri serivisi nto n'ibisubizo byuzuye byikora—turimo gukora ibikoresho by'ibanze bizakoresha ubucuruzi bw'ejo hazaza.
introduction.paragraph4: Dukurikire mu gihe dushaka igisubizo hamwe. Ntibirebana no kubaka porogaramu gusa; bireba gushyiraho urusobe rw'ubufatanye aho abakozi ba porogaramu, ubucuruzi n'abahanga udushya bishyira hamwe gukemura ibibazo nyabyo. Buri musanzu utanze ntufasha umushinga umwe gusa—uba igice cy'urufatiro rukura rukorera ubucuruzi butabarika ku isi hose.

transparency.description: Buri cyemezo, kuva ku miterere y'ikoranabuhanga kugeza ku ngamba z'ubucuruzi, cyanditse kandi kiraboneka ku muryango. Dukoresha GitHub gucunga codebase yacu n'ibiganiro, kugira ngo habeho gukorera mu mucyo, gukurikiranwa n'ubufatanye bweruye. Imisanzu igaragara ku mugaragaro, bityo buri mukozi wa porogaramu abona icyo yagezeho kandi akamenya ko uburyo bukoreshwa busobanutse kandi bwuzuye ubutabera.
